description: This PHP source file defines the I18NTranslationValidationAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for validating internationalization (i18n) translation strings within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for request validation and retrieval of validation results, utilizing various traits and external classes related to API endpoints, request parameters, and validation rules.

classes.name: I18NTranslationValidationAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for validating i18n translation strings, extending Endpoint and implementing ResourceEndpoint, with methods for handling validation requests and rules.
